entries.name: MTN balance menu
entries.description: Open the MTN Ghana balance menu for airtime, data and bundle balances. Widely published across operator and regulator consumer pages; the MTN help-centre itself was unreachable at last check, so this stays corroborated rather than verified.
instructions: Dial *124#.
Choose the balance to view from the menu.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Buy MTN data bundles
entries.description: Buy an MTN Ghana data bundle from the data menu. Widely published code; confirm the bundle menu if options change by plan or date.
instructions: Dial *138#.
Choose a bundle and confirm the purchase.
entries.costNote: Bundle prices vary by plan. Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Check my MTN number
entries.description: Display your own MTN Ghana phone number on screen. Widely published code; kept corroborated because the operator help-centre was unreachable at last check.
instructions: Dial *156#.
Your number is shown on screen.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Borrow airtime (XtraTime)
entries.description: Borrow airtime from MTN Ghana when you run out, repaid on your next recharge. Eligibility and fees are decided by MTN; widely published code kept corroborated pending an operator-page check.
instructions: Dial *506#.
Follow the menu to choose an amount and confirm.
entries.eligibility: Eligible MTN Ghana lines only; decided by MTN
entries.costNote: Borrowing fees, if any, are set by the operator.
entries.securityWarning: This creates a debt on your line repaid from your next recharge.

entries.name: MTN Mobile Money (MoMo)
entries.description: Open the MTN Mobile Money menu for balance, transfers, withdrawals, and bill payments. Widely published code; kept corroborated pending an operator-page check.
instructions: Dial *170#.
Follow the menu: send money, withdraw, pay bills, check balance.
entries.networkScope: MTN Mobile Money users in Ghana
entries.costNote: Transaction fees apply per MoMo tariff.
entries.securityWarning: This starts financial transactions. Never share your MoMo PIN or one-time codes with anyone.

entries.name: Telecel credit transfer

entries.costNote: Transfer limits and fees are set by Telecel.

entries.name: NHIS membership renewal and validity
entries.description: Renew NHIS membership or check validity from any phone network in Ghana. Confirmed on the official NHIA page: Option 1 checks validity, Option 2 renews; the page notes renewal works from any network.
instructions: Dial *929#.
Choose 1 to check validity or 2 to renew, then follow the prompts.
entries.eligibility: NHIS members and households renewing membership
entries.costNote: Renewal premiums apply; shown during the session.
entries.securityWarning: Do not share MoMo PINs or one-time codes while paying.

entries.name: ECG prepaid meter top-up
entries.description: Buy ECG prepaid electricity credit and load the token on your meter. Widely published service menu; kept corroborated pending an ECG-page check.
instructions: Dial *226#.
Choose prepaid top-up, enter your meter number, amount, and confirm.
entries.costNote: Vend amounts plus any service charge shown during the session.
entries.securityWarning: Only use your own meter number; tokens cannot be transferred.

entries.name: ECG postpaid bill enquiry
entries.description: Check an ECG postpaid electricity bill from the service menu. Widely published menu; kept corroborated pending an ECG-page check.
instructions: Dial *226#.
Choose postpaid/bill enquiry and follow the prompts.
entries.costNote: Bill amounts as issued by ECG.

entries.name: GRA tax services
entries.description: Reach Ghana Revenue Authority self-service options (TIN, filing help, taxpayer info) from the published short code menu. Kept corroborated pending a GRA-page check.
instructions: Dial *222#.
Choose the tax service you need from the menu.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.
entries.securityWarning: Never share passwords or one-time codes with anyone.

entries.name: GTBank mobile banking (*737#)
entries.description: GTBank Ghana mobile banking: transfers, airtime top-up, balance checks, and bill payments. Widely published bank code; kept corroborated pending a bank-page check.
instructions: Dial *737#.
Follow the menu for transfers, airtime, balance, or bills.
entries.costNote: Bank transaction fees apply where shown.
entries.securityWarning: This moves money. Never share your PIN or one-time codes with anyone.

instructions: Dial *326#.

entries.costNote: Bank transaction fees apply where shown.
entries.securityWarning: This moves money. Never share your PIN or one-time codes with anyone.

entries.name: WAEC results checker (Ghana)
entries.description: Check WASSCE results via the WAEC results service. Result-checker PINs are sold by WAEC; the code opens the results flow. Kept corroborated pending a WAEC-page check.
instructions: Dial *944#.
Follow the prompts and enter your result-checker details when asked.
entries.eligibility: Candidates with a valid WAEC result-checker PIN
entries.costNote: Result-checker PIN purchase and any session charges apply.
entries.securityWarning: Use only your own examination details.

notice: Each entry records the source page used for the last check. Corroborated codes are widely published but still awaiting an operator-page check; re-check with the operator if a code no longer matches. USSD menus can change by SIM, plan, device, or date.
